title: United States Study Visa Pakistan — Requirements, Fees & Process | SK Immigration
description: United States study visa from Pakistan: requirements, documents, fees, timeline, common mistakes and FAQ. Honest guidance by SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: What are the main requirements for a United States study visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Typically admission/offer documents, proof of funds, passport, academic records, and any language or medical checks United States requires. Exact lists change — SK Immigration builds a country checklist for your case.

faqs.question: How long does a United States student visa take from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Often 2–5 months after I-20, depending on interview wait times Peak intakes and incomplete files take longer.

faqs.question: What are typical fees for United States study visa Pakistan applicants?
faqs.answer: SEVIS + MRV fees + university deposits; SK packages from PKR 50,000. Official fees are paid to universities/missions; our service fee covers preparation only.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee the visa?
faqs.answer: No. Embassies and immigration authorities decide every application. We prepare honest, complete files and explain risks clearly.

faqs.question: Can SK Immigration help with attestation for United States?
faqs.answer: Yes — we sequence Apostille/MOFA/embassy steps when your destination requires legalized Pakistani documents.

faqs.question: Is IELTS always required?
faqs.answer: Not always. Some programs accept MOI letters, university tests or other evidence. We map realistic language pathways case by case.

body:
Requirements

  • Form I-20 from a SEVP-certified school
  • SEVIS fee payment and DS-160
  • Proof of funds covering tuition and living costs
  • Strong non-immigrant intent for F-1 interview
  • Academic and English readiness evidence

Process

  1. University applications and I-20 issuance
  2. SEVIS + DS-160 completion
  3. Interview coaching and document binder
  4. Embassy/consulate interview
  5. Visa stamp and travel planning

Documents

  • I-20 and SEVIS receipt
  • DS-160 confirmation
  • Passport
  • Bank / sponsor affidavits
  • Academic transcripts and test scores
  • Interview appointment confirmation

Interactive checklist: Open United States checklist →

Fees

SEVIS + MRV fees + university deposits; SK packages from PKR 50,000. Always verify current embassy and university fees before paying.

Timeline

Often 2–5 months after I-20, depending on interview wait times.

Common mistakes

  • Inconsistent answers about program choice or funding
  • Weak home ties explanation at interview
  • Paying agents who promise guaranteed F-1 approval
  • Incomplete sponsor documentation

USA F-1 study pathway from Pakistan

A typical US degree pathway uses an I-20 from a SEVP-certified school, SEVIS fee payment, DS-160, and a consular interview. Consular officers decide every F-1 case; SK Immigration prepares documents and interview consistency — never outcome guarantees.

Building blocks

  • Admission and Form I-20
  • SEVIS (I-901) fee payment evidence
  • Proof of funds covering tuition and living as shown on the I-20
  • Academic records and test scores required by the school (TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo — whatever the university states)
  • DS-160 + interview appointment

Process map

  1. University applications and scholarships/assistantships where relevant
  2. I-20 issuance after deposits/conditions
  3. SEVIS fee + DS-160
  4. Interview prep (ties, programme fit, funding clarity)
  5. Decision and travel / SEVIS registration planning

Interview focus areas

  • Why this university and major
  • Who pays and how funds were earned
  • Plans after graduation (honest temporary-intent framing under F-1 rules)
  • Consistency with documents — no coached lies
